provenance.change: Keep winding interior core, add a biome-specific generous return corridor.

route.interpolation: Uniform periodic cubic B-spline; C2 continuous at every knot and the lap seam.
route.returnDescription: Cloud terrace return through the west and northern shoulder; deep interior C bends retained.

island.shape: Original biome land retained; terrain added locally only where required for a generous return shoulder. No global silhouette scaling.

repeatableLapPlan.rule: Advance distance along the lap; sample at distance modulo total lap length. Continue for any song duration, repeating as needed.
repeatableLapPlan.speedOrScaleChoice: Choose eventual Unity scale and travel speed independently; this reference makes no fixed duration promise.

artHandoff.road: One wide continuous complex interior circuit. Never simplify to a shoreline ring or tile track. Road joins itself smoothly and has no physical ends.
artHandoff.passages: Only a short open-ended stone arch or bridge-like portal; both mouths and the continuous road remain visible. No long cave roofs or enclosed tunnels.
artHandoff.technology: Place 2–4 substantial technology buildings in off-road clear areas. Pads indicate broad candidate envelopes; preserve the full return road.
artHandoff.limits: Flat-plan geometry checks only; final art and reconstructed 3D geometry still need collision, elevation, camera occlusion and runtime checks.
